paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples with a larger number of examples

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates how the metric **minADE\_20 (↓)** varies as the **number of in-context examples** increases, comparing two selection methods labeled **ST-ES** and **Random**. The **x-axis** is labeled *“Number of Examples”* and uses a linear scale, spanning integer values from **0 to 15** with major tick labels shown at **0, 5, 10, and 15**. The **y-axis** is labeled *“minADE\_20 (↓)”* on a linear scale, with visible tick labels at approximately **15.0, 15.5, 16.0, 16.5, and 17.0**, and the plotted values extending from roughly the mid-**14.6–14.7** range up to just above **17.0**. The **ST-ES** series is drawn as a **blue solid line** with **circular markers**, starting near **17.1** at **0** examples, dropping sharply to about **15.2** at **1**, then decreasing more gradually to around **14.7** by about **6–8** examples; it stays close to **14.7** through the midrange (e.g., around **14.70** at **10** and about **14.66–14.68** around **11–13**) and ends near **14.74** at **15** examples. The **Random** series is drawn as an **orange solid line** with **circular markers**, beginning around **16.8** at **0** examples, decreasing to about **16.48** at **1**, and then remaining nearly flat with small fluctuations around **16.43–16.47** across the rest of the x-axis, ending close to **16.46** at **15** examples.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates minADE\(_{20}\) (with a downward arrow indicating lower values are preferable) as a function of the number of in-context examples, showing two methods labeled “ST-ES” and “Random.” The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 15 with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, and 15. The y-axis is labeled “minADE\(_{20}\) (↓),” uses a linear scale, and displays labeled ticks at 15.0, 15.5, 16.0, 16.5, and 17.0 (with the plotted values extending slightly above 17.0 and slightly below 15.0). The ST-ES series is drawn as a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts near 17.1 at 0 examples, drops sharply to about 15.2 at 1 example, then continues downward more gradually into the mid–14.7 range by around 5 examples, remains near 14.7 across most of the remaining x-values, and ends around 14.7–14.8 at 15 examples. The Random series is drawn as a solid orange line with circular markers; it begins near 16.8 at 0 examples, decreases to about 16.5 at 1 example, and then stays nearly flat around 16.45–16.50 through 15 examples with only small point-to-point fluctuations.
